build_SphereCradle_entity: build a concave sphere cradle entity with three spheres arranged in a circular pattern for prop placement
build_Pedestal_entity: build a pedestal entity with a capsule pillar and attached cradle for elevating target props
create_Place_task: create a Place task that configures a robot arm and hand to place a prop on a pedestal cradle
run_place_brick_features: run the place brick features task using perfect feature observations with a duplo cradle prop
run_place_cradle_vision: run the place cradle vision task using camera observations with a sphere cradle target
